name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Aged Care Home for Claude Code: reporting clocks, clinical risks and the roster, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Reportable incidents not yet reported
sections.note: SIRS Priority 1 within 24 hours of becoming aware, Priority 2 within 30 days. Section 31 as soon as practicable.
sections.sql: select reference, home, resident, coalesce('P' || sirs_priority || ' ' || sirs_type, 'Section 31') as scheme, to_char(aware_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as aware, to_char(report_due_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as due, case when report_late then 'PAST DUE' else '' end as flag from incident_clock where (sirs_priority is not null or s31_required) and reported_at is null order by coalesce(report_due_at, aware_at)

sections.title: Restrictive practices missing consent, a plan or a review
sections.sql: select resident, name, home, kind, description, case when no_consent then 'no consent' when no_plan then 'no plan' else 'review overdue' end as missing from restrictive_status where no_consent or no_plan or review_overdue order by home, resident

sections.title: Unplanned weight loss of 5% or more
sections.sql: select code, name, home, earlier_kg as then_kg, latest_kg as now_kg, change_pct || '%' as change from weight_trend where change_pct <= -5 and not planned_loss order by change_pct

sections.title: Open wounds
sections.sql: select resident, name, home, kind, stage, site, days_open, next_dressing_on, case when dressing_overdue then 'OVERDUE' else '' end as flag from wound_status order by home, resident

name: workforce
title: Workforce
subtitle: Care minutes, registrations and police checks

sections.title: Care minutes per resident per day, last 28 days
sections.note: Enrolled nurse minutes are shown on their own here; the CLI counts them toward the RN target up to 10% of it.
sections.sql: select home, jurisdiction, round(sum(total_minutes) / nullif(sum(residents), 0), 1) as total, max(care_minutes_target) as target, round(sum(rn_minutes) / nullif(sum(residents), 0), 1) as rn, max(rn_minutes_target) as rn_target, round(sum(en_minutes) / nullif(sum(residents), 0), 1) as en from care_minutes_daily where day >= current_date - 28 group by home, jurisdiction order by home

sections.title: Registrations and police checks inside 60 days
sections.sql: select code, full_name, role, home, registration_expires_on, screening_expires_on, last_shift_on from staff_checks where registration_days_left <= 60 or screening_days_left <= 60 order by least(coalesce(registration_days_left, 99999), coalesce(screening_days_left, 99999))

name: residents
title: Residents
subtitle: Every resident, their last interRAI and care plan review

sections.title: Residents
sections.sql: select home, room, code, name, status, care_level, days_here, last_interrai_on, last_care_plan_on, care_plan_due_on, latest_kg from resident_status order by home, room
